Scenario fixture: moving-content-pausable

Each target element has a stable id of the form mcp_case_NN. Only a browser runs animations: under jsdom, which has none, the rule is notApplicable, so the cases a browser asks about are marked BROWSER, a marker the fixture check does not read. tests/engine-checks/manual/moving-content-pausable-chromium.test.js checks them in Chromium.

A. Asked about in a browser — movement that starts by itself and lasts

01 — BROWSER: an animation that never ends (MOVING_CONTENT_LOOPS)

Breaking news

02 — BROWSER: a ten-second animation (MOVING_CONTENT_OVER_5S)

Welcome

B. Not asked about

03 — NEUTRAL: an animation over within five seconds

Look here

04 — NEUTRAL: an animated element that is not rendered

Not shown
